fields.Problem: Outreach was manual: every lead was qualified, followed up on and entered into the CRM by hand, for hours every day.
fields.System: An end-to-end pipeline that replaces manual outreach with intelligent workflows. Leads are qualified automatically, follow-ups sequenced and all data synced to Salesforce, with no human input at any step.
fields.Result: Eliminated hours of daily manual outreach. Scaled lead engagement without adding a single person.

fields.Problem: Coaching depended on hours of manual call review across sales and support teams.
fields.System: Automatically ingests, transcribes and scores calls against custom rubrics. It surfaces coachable moments and flags underperforming patterns, all before the manager opens their inbox.
fields.Result: Replaced hours of manual call review. Enabled consistent, data-driven coaching at scale.

fields.Problem: Invoices in every format, keyed in by hand across high-volume order flows.
fields.System: Reads incoming invoices in any format, extracts structured data, validates it against order records and writes clean entries to the database. Thousands of documents, no manual input required.
fields.Result: Eliminated manual invoice entry entirely. Scaled to high document volumes with zero additional effort.

fields.Problem: Loan applications were assembled by hand from unstructured financial documents, the slowest part of every review.
fields.System: An AI agent reads and interprets unstructured financial documents using vector search and LLMs, then populates and formats a complete loan application.
fields.Result: Drastically cut loan application processing time. Removed manual document review from standard application workflows.

about.title: Who I Am
paragraphs: I'm Deepankar Bhadrasen, an AI automation engineer based in Bhopal, India. I build intelligent systems that automate the workflows Fortune 500 teams rely on: sales pipelines, document intelligence, call grading, and content generation.

I've deployed over 20 AI agents and 10+ end-to-end systems across finance, e-commerce, and enterprise sales. Most of my work runs quietly in the background, replacing hours of manual labor with reliable, production-grade automation.

about.title: How I Got Here
paragraphs: I graduated from Symbiosis Centre for Management Studies, Pune, with a dual degree in Accounting and Finance and Marketing. In my final year, I discovered artificial intelligence and immediately saw where it was going.

So I pivoted everything. I started building obsessively, managing lectures and coursework by day while delivering AI automation solutions for real clients on the side. It was a grind, but the discipline of balancing college and client work taught me how to ship under pressure. I landed my first paying client before even graduating. That was the beginning.

What started as freelance work in college grew into founding-team contributions at a fast-growing AI company, consulting at enterprise events, and delivering systems for Fortune 500 clients, all within two years of picking up the field.

about.title: TrueHorizon AI
paragraphs: In early 2025, I joined TrueHorizon AI as a Founding Engineer, one of the first members of the team and an early risk-taker in building the company from the ground up.

I built core automation infrastructure that helped TrueHorizon scale to $2.5M ARR. My work spanned system architecture, client delivery, and building repeatable frameworks that served enterprise clients reliably at scale.

Today I am also building THAI UI, TrueHorizon AI's AI agent platform. I design the agents, skills and workflow automation that run inside it, and I develop the product around them too: the Vue interface and the Node and MongoDB services underneath. Claude Code and Codex are the coding agents I build it with.

about.title: Family, Inspiration and Ventures
paragraphs: My brother Anshul Namdev is the first community moderator of n8n and one of the most driven people I know. Watching him grow the n8n community while consistently pushing what was possible with AI agents has been a constant motivation for me to work harder and build bigger. He has been part of it from the very beginning.

Together, we co-founded Qixazow , a venture focused on turning complex AI ideas into practical, usable knowledge. The goal is straightforward: make AI automation genuinely accessible to anyone who wants to learn it seriously.

about.title: What I Use
paragraphs: I build on the latest AI automation stack: workflow orchestration, vector databases, and the enterprise platforms serious teams trust for privacy and security. I write code with Claude Code and Codex, and I build full stack when a system needs its own product around it. Everything I ship is production-proven, reliable and safe, and it stays updated to the bleeding edge of AI.
...plus Fireflies, Apify, and a list that keeps growing. Whatever your company already runs, my systems plug straight into it.

about.title: Work Together
paragraphs: If you're building something that requires serious automation, not a demo but a system that ships and scales, I'd like to hear about it.
